post.summary: ByteDance Seedream high-quality image generation and editing API. Supports text-to-image models doubao-seedream-3-0-t2i-250415, doubao-seedream-4-0-250828, doubao-seedream-4-5-251128, doubao-seedream-5-0-260128, and the doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628 image-edit model. High-resolution outputs with multiple aspect ratios.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the format of the response returned by the server. If not specified, the default format is `application/json`.

seed.description: Generate a random seed for image generation. The supported range is [-1, 2147483647], with a default value of `-1`. **Only `doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i` supports this parameter** (according to the official Volcengine documentation), other models do not accept this parameter.

size.description: Generate image dimensions or aspect ratios. Supports preset options (`1K`/`2K`/`3K`/`4K`), `adaptive` (adaptive reference image size), or explicit `<width>x<height>` format (e.g., `1024x1024`). **Different models support different preset options**: `doubao-seedream-5.0-pro` supports `1K`/`2K`; `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite` supports `2K`/`3K`/`4K`; `doubao-seedream-4.5` only supports `2K`/`4K`; `doubao-seedream-4.0` supports `1K`/`2K`/`4K`; `doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i` and `doubao-seedream-3.0-i2i` **do not support** any preset options and must receive explicit `<width>x<height>` values.

async.description: Is it processed in asynchronous mode? When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling `/seedream/tasks`; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

image.description: Reference image links for image editing are required, supporting accessible http/https URLs, or base64 encoded image strings in the format `data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KG...`. Each image must not exceed 10MB in size. This parameter is mandatory when using image-to-image models (such as `doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i`).

model.description: Models used for generating images. If not specified, the default is `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`. `doubao-seedream-5.0-pro` is the latest flagship single image model (only generates single images, does not support group images, streaming, or online search).

tools.description: List of tools that can be called by the model. Currently, only `web_search` is supported. Applicable only to `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`.

stream.description: Whether to return all images in a streaming manner, default is `false`. Only supports `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`, `doubao-seedream-4.5`, and `doubao-seedream-4.0`.

watermark.description: Whether to add AI-generated watermark, default is `true`.

callback_url.description: The callback URL after image generation is completed, which must be accessible from the public network. Once specified, the interface will return immediately, and the generation result will be asynchronously pushed to this callback address when ready.

output_format.description: The output image file format is `jpeg` by default. Only `doubao-seedream-5.0-pro` and `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite` are supported.

guidance_scale.description: Prompt word weight, the larger the value, the more relevant the generated result is to the prompt word. Only supports `doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i` (default value 2.5) and `doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i` (default value 5.5), both ranges are [1, 10].

response_format.description: The response format defaults to `url`, and also supports `b64_json`.

mode.description: Prompt optimization mode. `standard` has higher quality but is slower; `fast` is faster but has relatively lower quality.

optimize_prompt_options.description: Optional prompt word optimization configuration. Only supports `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`, `doubao-seedream-4.5` (only in `standard` mode), and `doubao-seedream-4.0`.

sequential_image_generation.description: The default value is `disabled`. Setting it to `auto` allows the model to generate a set of stylistically coherent related images (multi-image consistency, sharing characters, styles, and details across frames). Only `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`, `doubao-seedream-4.5`, and `doubao-seedream-4.0` are supported.

max_images.description: The maximum number of images that can be generated in this request is in the range of [1, 15]. Note: `（the number of reference images in 'image'） + （the number of images generated this time）` must not exceed 15.

sequential_image_generation_options.description: Adjustable parameters for batch image generation. Effective only when `sequential_image_generation=auto`. Only supports `doubao-seedream-5.0-lite`, `doubao-seedream-4.5`, and `doubao-seedream-4.0`.
